name: Baked Lemon Herb Chicken
instructions: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, garlic, rosemary, thyme, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pound chicken breasts to even thickness. Place in a baking dish.
Pour marinade over chicken, turning to coat. Marinate 30 minutes if time allows.
Bake 25-30 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing. Spoon pan juices over top.

substitutions.low_carb: Already low-carb — pair with roasted vegetables.
substitutions.vegan: Use the same marinade on thick cauliflower steaks or portobello mushrooms.

notes: Great for meal prep — slice and use in salads, wraps, or bowls all week.
